outcomeNote: The unit is a single editorial memory-sign; it argues nothing and settles nothing, only indexing the discussions that follow.

segments.he: (סִימָן: שַׁבָּת, חוֹרֵשׁ, וְכִלְאֵי זְרָעִים, אוֹתוֹ וְאֶת בְּנוֹ, וְשִׁילּוּחַ הַקֵּן).
segments.en: § The Gemara provides «a mnemonic» device for the topics that will be discussed: «Shabbat; plows; and diverse kinds of seeds; a mother and its offspring; and sending» away of the mother bird from «the nest.»

moves.summary: The anonymous voice supplies a mnemonic for the five topics — Shabbat, plowing, diverse kinds of seeds, a mother and its offspring, sending away the mother bird — about to be discussed in connection with Rav Ashi's statement cited in the preceding unit.
moves.about: a memory-sign listing, in order, the five topics the coming discussion will treat — Shabbat, plowing, diverse kinds of seeds, a mother and its offspring, and sending away the mother bird from the nest

edges.proposedPredicate: transmit.supplies_mnemonic_for — «סימן» — supplies a memory-sign fixing the order of items to be transmitted, here the topics of the coming series rather than rival tradents; transmits_from moves another's words, cites_source brings a text, and no closed predicate covers a purely mnemonic aid
